native_observations: NO true prefix. Parses ints1..4; consumes ALL remaining fields in pairs; calls CinemaFilms.Set. No task callback invoked.

Five fields are syntactically sufficient for OnResponse, but an empty film list makes CinemaFilms.Set loop forever because its loop tests the non-null list object while accumulated time cannot advance.

The authored local no-films suffix LOCAL_NO_FILMS#84600 is termination-safe: 1800+84600 reaches 86400, so Set adds no ScheduleFilm and exits after one iteration. Ticket-office and streaming-video consumers check the resulting schedule Count before indexing.
routes.minimum_success_fields_semantics: Parser-syntactic minimum only; unsafe with an empty film list because CinemaFilms.Set does not terminate.
routes.trailer_rule: No arbitrary trailer or trailing #; extra fields must be complete name/seconds pairs.
routes.candidate_policy: Authored local no-films compatibility response. LOCAL_NO_FILMS is a sentinel, not an original film identifier; duration 84600 prevents creation of a ScheduleFilm while allowing CinemaFilms.Set to terminate.
